mentions.name: Sudoku for reMarkable Paper Pro
mentions.description: A sudoku game built for the reMarkable Paper Pro e-ink tablet, designed for nightly play before bed with a cleaner, less messy board experience than paper or phone sudoku apps.
mentions.problem: Sudoku boards get messy when played on paper or phone apps.
mentions.source_excerpt:
After being frustrated with how messy my board can get, I decided to build an app for my reMarkable Paper Pro. In my opinion, it's a big step up from both paper and phone apps.

https://garbles.github.io/sudoku/
